tasks.description: `isRecordFile` matches root `OWNER-CALLS.md` (serves O1). Tests: record-files.test.js and custody.test.js (a change of only OWNER-CALLS.md returns none, not reverify).

Criterion covers: derive from TRD Touches via Serves, record as one atomic JSON file, read, and a CLI `record-criteria` in live-evidence.js (serves O2, O4). Includes a real-data case against docs/TRD/ci-baseline-check.md.

New change classes (ci-config, deps, docs), the `ensemble.reproof` setting, tier-aware `reconcile` and `affectedIds` in custody.js; compare() and check unchanged in meaning (serves O1, O2, O3). Depends on FIX-001, FIX-002.

Record covers when proven (implement-trd Step 8.4 and verify-build outcome step call record-criteria); document the setting in ship-custody-gate.md and docs/guides/ship-build.md; scaffold regression case (serves O3, O4). Depends on FIX-002, FIX-003.

requirements.statement: Under default rules, a change since the custody anchor that touches only docs, only a dependency lockfile, only a CI workflow file, or only OWNER-CALLS.md asks for no re-proof (custody.js reconcile returns none or moved, never reverify). Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O1 (roadmap item 2 brief, parts b, c, d)

requirements.statement: A shipped-code change re-proves only the must-pass criteria whose recorded covered files include a changed path; every proven criterion that maps to a TRD task carries such a record, so the no-record fallback applies only to a criterion with truly no record. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O2 (roadmap item 2 brief, parts a and d)

requirements.statement: The tier rules are a per-product setting, ensemble.reproof in .claude/settings.json: absent means defaults; a valid override changes the outcome; an invalid value stops custody with a reason naming the setting; scaffold-project.sh --refresh never overwrites an owner's value. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O3 (roadmap item 2 brief, part d)

requirements.statement: Covers are recorded at the moment criteria are proven: /implement-trd and /verify-build record them for every met criterion after the verification loop returns. Must pass: no.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O4 (roadmap item 2 brief, part a)

requirements.statement: classifyPath returns one of ignored, test-only, ci-config, deps, docs, shipped, checked in that order; ci-config, deps (lockfiles only) and docs (docs/ or doc/ first segment, or exact README/CHANGELOG/LICENSE-style basenames) are the new classes; manifests and *.md under packages/core/commands stay shipped. Stated in TRD Intended Change, After item 1 (unlabeled in the TRD).

compare() keeps its meaning: docs, deps and ci-config paths still make pr-head, merge and deploy links fail. check reads no setting. Tiers act only inside reconcile. Stated in After item 2 (unlabeled).
isRecordFile also matches the root-level path OWNER-CALLS.md (exact, repo-relative); classifyPath and mergeBase both read it. Stated in After item 3 (unlabeled).

ensemble.reproof keys docs (default none), testOnly (ci), ciConfig (ci), deps (ci), depsReprove (array, default []), format (none), shipped (covers). Values outside the allowed set, a non-array depsReprove, or invalid settings JSON return refused naming the setting; unknown keys are ignored; record files and the TRD are not configurable. Stated in After item 4 (unlabeled).

reconcile promotes a non-shipped path whose tier is reprove, or a lockfile hitting depsReprove; promoted paths put every must-pass criterion in doubt and the base excuse does not soften them. When all paths are non-shipped at tier none or ci, the anchor moves with move rule tier-none or tier-ci. Stated in After item 5 (unlabeled).

Covers recorded into one JSON file at <stateDir>/evidence/criterion-covers.json, written atomically; deriveCriterionCovers, recordCriterionCovers and readCriterionCovers exist; CLI record-criteria records only met ids and prints {recorded, none}. Stated in After item 6 (unlabeled).

affectedIds: live-evidence covers, then criterion-covers record, then no record (unchanged fallback). Guards: shipped all or any promoted path puts every id in doubt; an unclaimed shipped path (named by no record) puts every must-pass criterion in doubt. Stated in After item 7 (unlabeled).

implement-trd Step 8.4 and verify-build outcome step run record-criteria once; a failure is one ISSUES line, never STUCK; ship-custody-gate.md step 4 and docs/guides/ship-build.md name the setting. Stated in After item 8 (unlabeled).
scaffold-project.sh --refresh never writes ensemble.reproof; an owner's ensemble.reproof.docs value survives refresh (BATS regression case). Stated in After item 9 (unlabeled).

npx jest on custody.test.js, record-files.test.js and live-evidence.test.js passes with the new cases; bats on scaffold-project.test.sh passes with the new refresh case. Before the change the docs-only, lockfile, CI-workflow and OWNER-CALLS.md cases return reverify.

open_questions: OQ-1 Default tier rules: the strategy report's tier table as the roadmap states it, depsReprove empty (roadmap open question; default taken under --auto). Owner-only.
OQ-2 Which files count as docs: docs/, doc/ and exact README/CHANGELOG/LICENSE-style basenames, never every *.md (prompts are product here); an owner who serves docs/ sets docs: reprove. Owner-only.

OQ-3 Do dependency manifests count as deps? Assumed lockfiles only; manifests (package.json, pyproject.toml, mix.exs, Gemfile) stay shipped because they carry scripts, entry points or code (plan review finding; default taken unattended, 2026-11-11). Owner-only.
could_not_verify: That every real success definition names objective ids that deriveCriterionCovers can map; older definitions with no Must pass column and no objective or task id in a row get no record and keep today's fallback (by design).
The share of criteria that end up with a record on a real feature; measurable only on the next live /implement-trd run.
